drhp.business: The Company manufactures finished paper products from modern manufacturing facilities at Vapi and Sarigam in Gujarat, serving both domestic and international customers. Its product portfolio spans paper used in FMCG packaging, textbooks, print media and notebooks, with a stated focus on innovation, quality improvement and cost efficiency. It is expanding into the packaging board segment through a proposed multilayer board plant.

drhp.expansion: The Company's principal expansion is a new Multilayer Board Plant (Unit VI), undertaken during FY 2025-26 as a major expansion initiative to expand capacity in the packaging board segment. The proposed plant carries an estimated installed capacity of 1500 tonnes per day and a projected investment of approximately H1,500 Crores. As part of the project the Company has acquired a 4.3 metre deckle board paper machine (2013 make) with a capacity of 1020 TPD, along with pulp stock preparation equipment, and has initiated dismantling and relocation of the machinery to India. risks.note: The only risk the Company explicitly names anywhere in the routed material: 'A downturn in the economy could weaken consumer spending power, which may translate into lower demand for paper-based products.' Management's stated mitigation is that India's GDP growth of 7.6% in FY 2025-26 reflects resilience and consumption potential, offering wider opportunities despite cyclical pressures. (Read in the Corporate Overview 'Risk management' spread, page 19 — supplied in this workdir's profile/capex bundles, not in the risks bundle itself.)
